---
title: "Your Role: Taylor — Content Strategist"
---

*Do not share this with Jordan or Morgan before the roleplay begins.*

---

**Your situation:** Your parent was diagnosed with a serious illness two months ago. Every Friday morning you drive them to an early medical appointment — it's the only time slot available. You told Jordan about it and Jordan said, *"Do what you need to do"* — so you assumed it was fine. You've made sure your work is covered and you haven't missed any deadlines.

**Your goal:** Keep your Friday mornings free until your parent's treatment is complete (estimated 6–8 more weeks). You're not trying to avoid work — you're trying to handle a hard personal situation without losing your job or your standing on the team.

---

### How you're feeling

- Blindsided. You thought this was handled.
- A little embarrassed — you didn't realize Morgan was frustrated, and you don't want your personal situation to become office gossip.
- Quietly resentful that Jordan didn't just handle this instead of calling a meeting.

---

### What you're willing to do

- Offer to take extra calls in 6–8 weeks to make up for the missed rotations.
- Explain the situation to Morgan — you were trying to be private, not sneaky.

---

### Your hard limit

You will **not** agree to give up the Friday morning slot right now. That is non-negotiable.
